lead: Arun Jaitley was an Indian politician, born on 28 December 1952 in New Delhi.
He died on 24 August 2019 in All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi at the age of 66.
He has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha and Minister of Finance and has been recognised with CNN-News18 Indian of the Year and Outstanding Parliamentarian Award.
Below you will find a verified overview of Arun Jaitley: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Arun Jaitley — Career and Professional Work
paras: Arun Jaitley works primarily as a politician, lawyer, spokesperson, strategist and finance minister.

He has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha (2018–2019), Minister of Finance (2014–2019), Minister of Defence (2014–2014), Minister of Law and Justice of India (2003–2004), Minister of Defence (2017–2017) and Leader of the Opposition in the Rajya Sabha (2009–2014). He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
He has taken part in World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2015, World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2016, World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2018 and World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2019.
